sources.keyFinding: Of the battle part of M2 (the owner's Oct 20 pick, UI_DIRECTION §7 M2), only the girl and hero drawers shipped (A3 M4, v0.1.57 'tactical drawer'). The HUD strip (battle.css:30-38, from Oct 5), the card rail band (battle.css:143-150, from Oct 8), the cost strip, the live tree, the hold sheet, the boss band, the results sheet and the pause menu were never rebuilt. UI_V2_MENUS §5 and §7 sent them to the abilities lane after the ultimates merge, and nothing picked them up. No later owner decision replaces them, so those diffs are unbuilt work (DRIFT), not regressions.

missedByReviewers.what: Reviewer error: the idle 844 still has 3 abilities, and its '×2' is a copy-count sticker, not '+2'. The 8-slot cast scene is within ABILITIES §8.1's 11-slot limit. No inconsistency exists, so the 'cap at 3' fix should be dropped.
The Rewards sheet prints 'x2817' Coins outside fmtNum (should be ×2,817, UID §2/P5). It also lists 'Momo 47 dmg · 0%', a zero row (P7).
The boss bar adds 2 always-on numbers ('883.2k / 883.2k' at full HP) on top of the 7 HUD numbers. Not in either mock.
The armed row's effect chips ('SELF', '+2 dmg', 'Ignores 2 armor') look about 10-11 px at 844. Measure against the 12 px floor (P6).
The ability hold card's footer ('Recharges in 35s of wave time · Around her') looks under 12 px at 844 (P6).
At 390x844 the hero widget row (portrait, ring, skill, LV UP) spans about 70% of the width over the road's last bend above the goal. The v0.1.58 lift only checks the goal and start points.
Before wave 1 the HUD reads 'WAVE 0/12', a zero state (P7).
At 844 the ability slots sit flush on the card rail's top edge, and the ×2 sticker overlaps the rail band.

At 1280 the settings rows print helper sentences ('Show her attack range while you drag…', 'Girls fire their abilities by themselves…'). This goes against the owner's Nov 3 rule to cut helper text (HANDOFF_2026-11-01 §0, UI simplicity). Route it to that track.

top8.fix: Rebuild the live upgrade tree and the hold sheet to §6.1: node rows with owned/next/later/locked rings, prices only on next cells, and a right detail panel. Give the full tree its own Buy (owner Oct 20). Remove the opacity-0.5 lock, the ellipsis, the per-cell tags, the card column and the repeated rule. Also clamp the ability hold card under the HUD.
Build the boss warning band (M2 owner pick): a hazard-striped band with a 'BOSS · PHASE n/N' kicker, the name in display type and one traits line. Clamp it to 1.2 s on every screen.

Restyle the HUD top strip: tactical ink plates floating over the map and a segmented WAVE bar. Drop the NEXT wave number and the ×N counts (keep them on tap), and drop the stage/difficulty chip, which already sits in pause. That brings the HUD to 4 numbers + speed.

Card rail: remove the navy band and left-align the cards. Use a 22 px cost strip at --fs-num-s in --plate-accent, a 2 px white border with a pink selected ring, and 12 px HERO/New!/WAVE labels. Add an ON FIELD strip, and hide the HERO tag when she is deployed (keep FREE).

390x844 portrait: show 3 ability slots before +N (ABILITIES §8.1). In the drawer sheet, make the footer a solid plate, hide the rail behind it, and aim for ≤50% coverage. Keep the hero widget row clear of the road bend.

Pause menu: style .bt-seg (no CSS exists today, so the controls render as grey browser buttons), add a --plate header with a 44 px close, print the difficulty once, and fold Settings so the actions fit at 844.

Victory and Rewards (M4): show a drops row and a Next Stage primary on the Victory Glance. Put the stat tiles on an ink strip and the freeplay strip on a plate with its rule behind 'i' (keep 'Wave 15/14'). Clear the FINAL WAVE ribbon on a win. Format ×2,817 and hide 0% damage rows.
Hero drawer and widget: add the UR tag, a pink range ring and a legible XP bar. Ask the owner two questions: hug-content height vs §5.4 full height, and the ult ring seconds (§6.6 vs P3).
